# Johnson Controls named to TIME's 2026 Best Inventions list


October 15, 2026


Share


-
-
-
-


Johnson Controls[YORK® YDAM](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/media-center/news/press-releases/2026/02/03/johnson-controls-launches-york-ydam-the-ultimate-highdensity-chiller-for-multistory-data-centers-and) data center cooling solution has been named to[TIME's 2026 Best Inventions list](https://time.com/collection/best-inventions/2026/?filters=AI) in the AI category. The annual list highlights 300 inventions making the world better, smarter and more fun.


Introduced in 2026, YORK YDAM helps data centers keep up with the rapid growth of AI. Its compact, air-cooled design delivers powerful cooling without using onsite water, helping customers support growing demand while using less space.


This recognition reflects Johnson Controls commitment to advancing innovative technologies that help customers meet the demands of the AI era.
